notes: Only IS 2018-2022 is used; forward labels are truncated at 2022-12-31.
D10 is the equal-weight top-decile portfolio excess vs EW members, annualized as mean(daily)*252/h.
Direction is chosen by the highest peak D10 across h=1..10.
Normal lifetime is the D10 half-life; delayed lifetime is the half-height window around the peak.
Delayed factors are not sub-grouped; start, end and width are reported.
